needsResponse.title: Back-to-school checklist + medical forms
needsResponse.body: Complete the Back-to-School Checklist and medical forms in Blackbaud. Medical forms were originally due Aug 15; the deadline was extended to Friday Sep 4.

upcoming.title: Maplewood bus starts
upcoming.body: Pickup on Pierson Road between Burnet and Valley. Not the first week of school — drive until then if Red Oaks is in session.
upcoming.location: Pierson Road between Burnet and Valley

upcoming.title: Parent Welcome Back Breakfast
upcoming.uncertainNote: Treating Thu Sep 10 as canonical (email subject said 9/10). An image alt text incorrectly said Fri Sep 5.

scheduleNotes.title: First instructional day
scheduleNotes.body: Not listed in the mail — unknown. Drive Hugo if school is in session before the bus starts Tue Sep 8.

scheduleNotes.title: Bus on delays and closures
scheduleNotes.body: 2-hour delay → 9:20am pickup. If SOMSD or Morris SD is closed, the Maplewood bus does not run even if Red Oaks is open.

needsResponse.title: Get teacher assignment in PowerSchool
needsResponse.body: Posted Friday Aug 28. The school will not give teacher names by phone or email — check PowerSchool.

needsResponse.title: Pick up one teacher welcome letter
needsResponse.body: File box outside the front door on Virginia Road. One letter per family.
needsResponse.location: File box outside the front door, Virginia Road

needsResponse.title: Bolden PTA class captain form
needsResponse.body: Optional. Sign up if you want to be a class captain.

needsResponse.title: Watch for first-day email from the principal
needsResponse.body: Principal said a Monday Aug 31 email is coming with first-day arrival, dismissal, and breakfast. Not in the inbox as of Saturday Aug 29. District mail comes from somsd.k12.nj.us.

upcoming.title: SOMSD first day of school
upcoming.body: Universal breakfast starts. Bell-to-bell smartphone, smartwatch, and earbud ban. Elementary Chromebooks stay at school.

scheduleNotes.title: First day · Tue Sep 1
scheduleNotes.body: Universal breakfast starts this day. Bell-to-bell ban on smartphones, smartwatches, and earbuds. Elementary Chromebooks stay at school.
